# Electric Technocracy Community Navigator

> Multilingual dossier and research navigator on Electric Technocracy: a community-driven knowledge base covering people, places, installations, cable lines, and units, with full-text search across 600+ source PDFs in 33 languages.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](/index_en.html): English entry point and overview of the navigator.
- [Home (multilingual)](/): Language picker and global landing page.
- [Search](/search.html): Full-text search across all indexed PDFs and chapters.
- [Cross-reference index](/xref.html): People, places, installations, cable lines and units with in-page backlinks.
- [Sitemaps overview](/sitemaps.html): Per-language sitemap index.
- [Audit log](/audit.html): Build, indexing and link-audit reports.
